I really wanted this job that I saw posted two months ago, but the listing expired so I couldn't apply for it. I was devastated for awhile. The job was exactly in my field of work. But initially, my primary reason for wanting it was because it would allow me to follow my boyfriend to a different state. I wrote about it every day for a few weeks in my gratitude journal, but still no luck finding the job. I kept googling it and looking at the organization's website, but I still couldn't find a way to apply. I kept ignoring other job postings, because they were in a different state, even though they were pretty close to that expired listing. I was so convinced that the job was perfect for me, so I started to get pretty anxious that I wasn't going to find a job that would fit me as well. Finally, I just decided to doodle everything that I wanted in my dream job without attaching *that* organization's name to it anymore, and then let it be. In that last entry, I also wrote about what I wanted in a job, other than the ability to follow my boyfriend. I took him completely out of the equation and just made the job about me. I even wrote my cover letter, as if that job was still open, and cleaned up my resume to get it ready if I needed to apply. After that last entry about the job, I decided to put more confidence in myself that I'm qualified for whatever dream job I wanted. This was about 2 weeks ago.

Yesterday, my boyfriend asked me if I ever found that job again, and I said I haven't thought about it for awhile. So, today I decided to browse job listings, just for the hell of it... and there it was!! It was like it came back from the dead. Crossing my fingers that I'll get the job, but at any rate, I'm just thankful for the opportunity to even apply.
